mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (its arduino-lib-builder 6671d0b on ESP-IDF v5.5.5, from the image's esp_app_desc_t); the core's SD and SPI libraries, Adafruit_ILI9341 and Adafruit_GFX as the build image shipped them (versions not pinned)
firmware.fqbn: esp32:esp32:esp32s3 (default options: 4 MB quad flash, DIO)

bootloader.bin.note: the core's default S3 bootloader, 4 MB flash header

firmware.not_committed: A plain Arduino build of the sketch; not added to the repository.

runs.spi3: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app spi3.bin --console uart0 --debug spi --max-seconds 6 --no-dump
runs.note: Board `none` answers every MISO byte with 0xff: the ILI9341 init goes out on SPI2 (write-only), the SD card's CMD0 goes out on SPI3 and gets no card, so the sketch prints `tft ready` and then `mount failed` once a second; the point is which controller each transfer leaves on
